criterion.driven: in the transitive import closure of a module that registers a Channel (the headline; least flattering)
criterion.entry-script: a derive_*/run_* script with a __main__ that nothing imports — meant to be RUN, not a defect
criterion.note: Edges are `static` (an ast.Import) or `dynamic` (a string literal naming a module — how casim.fields.* shims work). np/scipy/fft site counts are REGEX, for C1/C2 sizing only.
criterion.package-only: reachable from src/casim but not from any registered channel — CLI, suite, analysis, shims
criterion.unreferenced: nothing in the tree references it
